title: Spirit of Mercy, Truth, and Love
description: Spirit of Mercy, Truth, and Love in Tonic Solfa to OLD HUNDREDTH, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 250.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to OLD HUNDREDTH; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Spir-it of mer-cy, truth, and love, O shed Thine in-fluence from a-bove And still from age to age con-vey The won-ders of this sa-cred day.

lines: Spirit of mercy, truth, and love,
O shed Thine influence from above
And still from age to age convey
The wonders of this sacred day.
In every clime, by every tongue,
Let all the listening earth be taught
The wonders by our Savior wrought.
Still o’er Thy holy Church preside;
Still let mankind Thy blessings prove,
Spirit of mercy, truth, and love.

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1927.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to OLD HUNDREDTH by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
